_comment: What each UI command does on the SOLO PICO. Only object NAMES are used here; their addresses and types are in canopen/devices/solopico.json. Values are in the object's own units (A, rpm, counts). Keys starting with '_' are comments.

direction._comment: Written when a mode with uses_direction starts. SetMotionCommand direction byte: 0 = CW, 1 = CCW.

stop._comment: rpm/s. Only does something after SPEED mode; it is already 0 after TORQUE / POSITION, so it is a single write.
Ramp down at 0.5 A/s, starting from the MEASURED current when it is lower than the reference (unloaded motor). If a write fails, 0 is written directly.
Freewheel. Every stop step runs even if an earlier one failed.

home._comment: Current position becomes 0. Refused while running.

torque._comment: Setpoint in mA, written in A (q17). max = current_limit (10 A). Ramped at 0.5 A/s, also on a live update.

speed._comment: Setpoint in rpm (magnitude; the direction byte picks the sign). max = speed_limit. The rpm scale is only right once encoder_lines in solopico.json is the real value.

position._comment: Absolute target in encoder counts, 0 = home. The target is written before the drive is enabled, so it never moves to a stale target. Travel speed is limited by speed_limit.

legacy_run._comment: SetRunStopCommand (0x40) RUN: the fixed torque run, 5.75 A clockwise.
